title: [v0.91.8][WP-22] Review and schedule the v0.92 milestone plan
body:

- schedules approved Runtime, distributed-polis, workflow, protocol, consumer, proof, cleanup, and release work
- records explicit technical deferrals and later publication/research backlog without dropping source pointers
